Add a 2-D preference vector `ω = (ω_perf, ω_cost)` on the simplex (`ω_perf + ω_cost = 1`) read from request metadata (default ω = (0.5, 0.5)).

Add calibrated cost scaling parameter τ as a runtime knob (env var `DAR_COST_TAU`, default 1.0; canonical env `ORCHESTRATOR_MEMRL_RETRIEVAL_COST_TAU` takes precedence). τ multiplies the normalized-cost penalty.
